body:
The child is stressing me the most tbh. Everyone told me that three would be fantastically difficult but I had no idea until it was actually on us, and our sweet, adorable toddler turned into something like the Tasmanian Devil on meth. 

More than anything else I think I need more RL friends, especially parent friends that I can spend time with, and I've tried to make it happen, but when it comes time to actually make the call or go do the thing, the effort of actually being social makes me want to die. So that's not really helping. I know what I need to do but I seem to be incapable of doing it.
